class.name: MaszynaTrianglesSector
class.brief_description: The terrain of one section of the 1 km grid, as one file.
class.description: As the original keeps a section ([code]basic_section[/code], scene.cpp:811): its own chunks - a texture each - and its cells' - a texture and a range in a 250 m cell each, its shapes merged within 25 m its groups ([MaszynaTrianglesChunkGeometry]). Each chunk is streamed and built on its own by its index here; the file is read once for all of them ([ResourceLazyLoader], keyed by its path).
